raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 9, Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly found the directors and their birth years (Marco Ferreri 1928; Laurent Tirard 1967) and even stated Tirard was born later, but then inverted the film mapping in the final answer, incorrectly concluding that Diary of a Maniac has the later-born director instead of Return of the Hero.
